authorship: Ten independently authored project modules, informed by documented method/marker semantics. No copied or transliterated upstream implementation is bundled.
code_terms: MIT for original project source only; complete project notice in LICENSE.txt and repository LICENSE.
controls: Retain all13 canonical holds, prior/order/premarker/permutation/competentEEG paired requirements, source/reference adequacy, raw input and nuisance/custody gates.
dictionary: Only its public identity/interpretation is referenced; raw3912-byte dictionary is not bundled. Delivered-prefix timing/information opportunity remains unresolved.
external_urls: Unsigned public citations/acquisition locators only; no request or acquisition is performed by publication. Presence does not establish access, permission to execute or local custody.
history: history/NEURAL-002.prior.json preserves the original MEG definition verbatim. It is superseded historical planning, not this Morse endpoint or a fulfilled measured-word/comprehension claim.
private_evidence: Unpublished development/review/metadata-custody descriptors are explicitly marked not distributed. Their bytes/hash identify the original evidence, never this summary. Complete private inverse retained by the project.
public_metadata: All320 descriptor rows for five file roles across64 recordings join the715-entry public tree. Public subject pseudonyms contain no new identity attribution or participant target values. Annex pointer extents are not signal payload extents.
public_payloads: Project source/documentation only. No authentic array, EEG, audio, MAT, header/event/behavior table, query answer, weight, key, raw stimulus dictionary, primary full text or original MATLAB source is included.
scope: All32 participants,64 recordings, six cells,26 raw IDs per cell,32 held-person folds and marker0–500ms inclusive301 samples. Early information assay, not complete-character/comprehension/physical-onset proof.
third_party_rights: No grant for original MATLAB code is inferred from datasetCC0. Original software remains an external reference, not bundled.
